interpretation.labels: Fixed, authored fixtures; not independently adjudicated domain outcomes.
interpretation.decisionAdapter: Deterministic test double that selects passed only after independent evidence passes; model accuracy is not measured.
interpretation.humanApproval: human_review_approved cases simulate a host-authored approval receipt; this does not test production approval identity/signature validation.

limitations: This measures host artifact scope/freshness gates and Goal DAG review/dependency enforcement, not the accuracy of Clef Flash, OpenRouter, Gemini, or GroqCloud.
Injection cases prove worker success claims do not substitute for absent host evidence; they do not test a malicious document through a live model judge.
Explicit human_review_required criteria remain in review even when an artifact check passes; the kernel does not infer that a criterion is subjective when authors omit this declaration.
The simulated human-review receipt is host-fixture data, not a live authenticated human approval action.
